name: ultra-realistic-billiards-goddess-shot
image_purpose: Lifestyle sports portrait and social editorial content

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic billiards portrait of an approved adult woman preparing a precise pool shot in a modern pool hall.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with a feminine silhouette and natural proportions, wearing the reference's secure white sleeveless fitted top, white high-waisted skirt with comfortable coverage, and closed-toe black heels. Preserve her face and body proportions from the required reference without body modification.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical composition from a slightly low three-quarter angle. She leans forward with natural spine alignment, cue aligned with the dominant arm, realistic hand bridge over the professional green-felt table, and focused gaze on the cue ball. Include several pool tables and hanging lights in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft-contrast interior cinematic lighting from overhead pool-table pendants, gentle reflections on skin and fabric, warm neutral room ambience, and realistic shadows enhancing the silhouette without body-part emphasis.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame DSLR, 50mm prime, f/1.8, ISO 400, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes and upper body, ultra-detailed 4K realism, natural skin texture, subtle film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic cinematic full-body vertical portrait of one approved adult woman with a feminine silhouette and natural proportions, wearing a secure white sleeveless fitted top, white high-waisted skirt with comfortable coverage, and elegant closed-toe black heels. In a luxury modern pool hall she leans forward with natural spine alignment, preparing a precise billiards shot; cue aligned with her dominant arm, realistic hand bridge over a professional green-felt table, focused gaze on the cue ball. Overhead pool-table pendants create soft-contrast reflections, warm neutral ambience, realistic shadows, full-frame DSLR 50mm f/1.8 ISO 400, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes and upper body, natural skin texture, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, extreme body proportions, body-part emphasis, transparent fabric, exposed underwear, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicate limbs, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random logos, low resolution, blur
